translations.text: [?] many peoples who are alien to God through defilements, impurities, thefts, and every evil deed. This is how it will be in the last days: whoever wishes to be righteous among those who live in this place, whether male or female, will be compelled by God to be faithful among many peoples who are alien to God through impurities, deceit, and every kind of lawlessness.

And at that time, theft, lying, laughter, mockery, their ridiculing one another, slander, grumbling, excessive greed, favoritism, insatiability, boasting, insults expressed in idle words, fights, disputes, hatred, jealousy, hostility, quarrels with one another, foolishness, and ignorance—these and many other things will no longer be counted as sins by the ungodly who will be among us at that time, whether male or female.
And because their evil deeds have multiplied, they will not understand that children who have become defiled are alien to God, according to the Scriptures.

For this reason, the sexual immorality of their hearts will exceed the sexual immorality of their loins, and the sexual immorality of their loins will exceed the sexual immorality of their hearts. Both will rise up against them as they are overwhelmed by eating, drinking, and many luxuries, especially as they increase in idleness and leisure and neglect all the righteousness of God.

And because they have not put to death their earthly members—sexual immorality, impurity, negligence, and all the rest—Satan will rise up against them with all his defiling activities, which we chase out of all the congregations and out of them. And they will commit many acts of sexual immorality, defilement, impurity, and deceit through Satan and his unclean spirits, who plan with me the evil that will occur at that time.
And at that time, righteousness, truth, and every kind of diligence will hide themselves from those unclean people, and lying and negligence will assert themselves boldly over them.
But righteousness, truth, and every kind of diligence will not hide themselves from the faithful who will live at that time—or rather, even now. And it will never happen.
Nor will lawlessness, lying, and every kind of negligence assert themselves boldly over the faithful who will live at that time—or rather, even now. And it will never happen.

For this reason, now, just as every believer in every congregation that exists according to our way of life—or rather, everyone who fears the Lord in every place—acts boldly in all righteousness and every good deed, trampling down all lawlessness and every deceit,

This, too, is how the faithful who will live at that time will act boldly in righteousness and every good deed, here and with everyone everywhere. They will trample on Satan, all his impurities, and all his uncleanness. Neither the devil, nor a sinful person, nor anything lawless will ever be able to prevent them from calling out to the Lord in truth at any time.

Instead, they will prevail mightily over Satan and all his other evil deeds, and they will prove themselves righteous through the abundance of their righteous deeds among the wicked who will live at that time, like Abel, who was righteous in every kind of righteousness in the midst of Cain, who was truly ungodly beyond anyone else.
And like Enoch and Noah and all the others who were righteous in every kind of righteousness among all those whom God wiped from the earth in a flood of abundant water.
And like Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, who were righteous in every kind of righteousness among all those who oppressed them.
And like Lot among the people of Sodom and Gomorrah, who were truly ungodly and more wicked than anyone else, according to the Scriptures.

And like Moses, Aaron, Miriam, and Joshua, who were righteous in every kind of righteousness among those who were disobedient, those who grumbled, those who committed sexual immorality, and those who craved food they did not have.
And like the judges who were righteous in every kind of righteousness among all these people, some of whom are those who abandoned God and followed foreign gods.
Not only did the holy people please God among those of their own number who became ungodly, but they also proved truly good and faithful before the Lord among the nations that do not know God.

All the prophets, all the apostles, all the saints, and everyone who fears the Lord, from the beginning down to this day, have been righteous in every kind of righteousness among those who are godless [?] and worthless before God, from the beginning until now.
We have said these things in this way so that we may understand that, just as neither the devil nor anyone who sins has been able to hinder any person from the beginning until now,
so they will never be able to hinder them, because Jesus is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

Everyone who wishes [?] to fulfill every kind of righteousness follows the good desires of their heart through God, and everyone who wishes to carry out their evil deeds at all times follows the evil desires of their heart through Satan.
But just as all the saints were afflicted among the ungodly who existed from the beginning,
so the righteous will also be afflicted among all the ungodly, in every congregation that has come into being in our way of life, and in every place where people sin throughout the whole earth.
And in this same way, the faithful who will be among us in the last days will also be greatly afflicted.

And just as the prophet's word is being fulfilled at this present time against every congregation that exists in our way of life, because of those who sin within them: “How have you turned into a bitter vine that has become alien to God through all its defilements and abominations?”

so also in the last days the prophet's word will be fulfilled against those who live in this place, because of those among them who will sin, whether male or female, when he says: “The Lord called their name an olive tree, beautiful to look at and giving shade. At the sound of its pruning, now a fire has been kindled upon it.”
Great is the affliction that is upon [?].
For its branches have become useless, from the beginning until now, and forever.

For everyone who sins anywhere throughout the whole earth, the words of the prophets are fulfilled against them, saying: “I will sing a song of love to my beloved, my vineyard.” And after all the words he spoke that follow these, he says: “I waited for it to produce grapes, but it produced thorns.”
Look, the rest of these words are on the sheets written earlier.
so too a righteous king is courageous, together with those who belong to him, and is always among them.

And whenever their enemies come to fight against them and all those who belong to the king, they rise up against their enemies and overtake them, and they do not return until they have destroyed them.
This is also how it is whenever everyone, at all times, keeps the Lord’s commandments in every congregation, in every place throughout the whole earth: God is with them.

And whenever Satan rises up against them to wage war on them, they call upon the name of the King of glory, Jesus, the Lord, the mighty and strong one, the Lord who is powerful in battle. And he sends them help through his holy angels. Everyone with whom the Lord is present pursues the demonic enemies, and they do not return until they have wiped out Satan and all his other evil deeds.

For this reason, just as all our holy fathers, from righteous Abel down to today, drove Satan and every evil deed out of themselves, their congregations, their sons, their daughters, their brothers, their companions, and everyone who fears the Lord and who had received instruction and obeyed them in everything,

so too, now and forever, everyone who keeps God’s commandments drives the Satans and all their other deeds out of themselves, like those who pursue robbers who want to plunder houses full of silver and gold. And they drive them out of their congregations, like those who pursue wild beasts that want to seize and scatter the sheep of the flock.

And they drive them out of their sons, their daughters, and their companions, like those who pursue foxes that want to destroy very fine vineyards, according to the Scriptures: “Catch for me little foxes that destroy the vineyards.”
And in the same way, they also drive them out of everyone who fears the Lord, receives their instruction, and keeps their words.

And if anyone, at any time, acts honestly in what they do, in every good work, and does not waver over the instruction of those who teach them from the Scriptures in the fear of the Lord, they will pursue Satan and every evil thing and blow them away through the power of the Spirit of God, like chaff carried far away by a strong wind, and like dust and debris that no one will ever fear, which the wind scatters from the face of the whole earth, according to the Scriptures.

In this same way, at all times and forever, we will never fear tens of thousands of demons fighting against us all around, as it is written. But just as Satan has prevailed from the beginning over everyone because of their evil deeds,
so he also prevails over everyone who lies and refuses to listen to those who teach them from the Scriptures in the fear of the Lord.
Therefore, if people sin while others plead with them not to sin, how much lawlessness will people who love evil commit when those who command them not to sin before the Lord depart from them?
And this is how Moses spoke in anguish: “While I am still with you, you provoke God. How, then, will you not provoke him after my death?”

Therefore, it is no wonder that some of us sinned while our holy fathers who have fallen asleep were pleading with us. Nor is it any wonder that they sinned after our holy fathers who have fallen asleep departed from us.

It is no wonder if they sin while our fathers who are with us now plead with us, weeping over us and urging us, firmly commanding us to keep the commandments and charging us by the Lord Jesus not to act deceitfully before the Lord.
Nor, again, is it any wonder if we sin when our fathers who are with us now, who grieve over us day and night, depart from us.
Has any prophet ever arisen in Israel like Moses?
And great multitudes sinned after he had departed from them, and after he had instructed them with all his words, after they had seen many wonders.
Is there anyone superior to all the prophets? Yet great multitudes sinned after the prophets had commanded them through all their words, and after they had seen many wonders.
Is there anyone greater than Jesus, the Son of God? Yet great multitudes sinned after he had commanded them through all his words, and after they had seen countless signs and wonders.

Are there others as mighty in their power as our fathers the apostles? Yet great multitudes sinned after the apostles had commanded them through all their words, after they had seen many signs and wonders. So if all these people sinned while all these holy ones were with them, each in his own time,
and while the Lord Jesus himself, the Son of God, was also with them on earth,

and all these people sinned and fell away from the hope of eternal life—not only did many peoples sin while all these holy ones were with them, but countless peoples also sinned after all these holy ones departed from them on the day of their visitation—

just as we ourselves now sin, or have sinned, after hearing the words of all these holy ones, those of the apostles, those of the prophets, those of our Lord Jesus, and those of all our fathers from the beginning, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and all the words of everyone who fears the Lord, down to this very day.
And if, after all these things, we sinned before the Lord, not only in our fathers’ house, in our childhood and our ignorance, but also after we had received a share in the knowledge of the truth,

And if those who want to fulfill their desires at all times sin fearlessly before the Lord, like the angels who abandoned their own position and committed sexual immorality with the daughters of the people of ancient times, and like all the others who have sinned from the beginning until now,

then who is Shenoute, or what are all his words, that he could prevent or restrain people among us who love evil, whether male or female, who want to carry out their sins at all times through deceit, theft, false oaths, fights, and accusations against one another, like the man who accused his brothers, saying that they had sinned, without knowing whether they had sinned or had not done it?
But in fact it is he who sinned in many ways: first, he defiled the temple of God in his childhood.

And when he confessed his sexual immorality, at the time when the fear of the Lord was examining him through the person questioning him, who wanted to help him, to take him out of Satan’s hands, to pull him out of the mire of lawlessness, and to save him from the wrath of God
yet again, after some years, he turned back and denied the truth, though no one questioned him.
